context: M2 o1. Corwin lobby, Saturday evening. Bernard reads the notice taped over the mailboxes.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: Mr. Arce. Come, hear literature. 'Notice to all residents of the Corwin Hotel.'

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: 'The premises have been acquired by Corwin Residential Associates.' Capital A.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: 'Inquiries to H. Lisle, counsel.' Counsel. A lawyer who signs with an initial.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: What does it mean, Mr. Ostrow? In words a person uses.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: It means somebody bought us, Mrs. Pruitt. And they haven't said what for.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: A man who writes 'notwithstanding.' I'll know more when I've seen him type.
